title: fix/lp2078356-jammy → ubuntu/jammy-devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index dfe086f..d6c9978 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,15 @@
+python3-defaults (3.10.6-1~22.04.2) jammy; urgency=medium
+
+  * Avoid false hook failures (LP: #2078356).
+    Backport Debian commit 2a6a6c96053d.
+    - d/python3.preinst.in: Use an initialized private variable for
+      pre-rtupdate hook errors.
+    - d/python3.postinst.in: Use an initialized private variable for rtupdate
+      and post-rtupdate hook errors.
+    - d/control, d/control.in: Update Maintainer for Ubuntu changes.
+
+ -- Seyeong Kim <seyeong.kim@canonical.com>  Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:17:07 +0900
+
 python3-defaults (3.10.6-1~22.04.1) jammy; urgency=medium
 
   * Don't use shell when calling dpkg -L
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index b5d64c0..8c3e5b6 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -1,7 +1,8 @@
 Source: python3-defaults
 Section: python
 Priority: optional
-Maintainer: Matthias Klose <doko@debian.org>
+Maintainer: Ubuntu Developers <ubuntu-devel-discuss@lists.ubuntu.com>

 Uploaders: Piotr Ożarowski <piotr@debian.org>, Stefano Rivera <stefanor@debian.org>
 Build-Depends: debhelper (>= 11), dpkg-dev (>= 1.17.11), python3.10:any (>= 3.10.6-1~),
   lsb-release,
diff --git a/debian/control.in b/debian/control.in
index ef0c846..d0ffe27 100644
--- a/debian/control.in
+++ b/debian/control.in
@@ -1,7 +1,8 @@
 Source: python3-defaults
 Section: python
 Priority: optional
-Maintainer: Matthias Klose <doko@debian.org>
+Maintainer: Ubuntu Developers <ubuntu-devel-discuss@lists.ubuntu.com>
+XSBC-Original-Maintainer: Matthias Klose <doko@debian.org>
 Uploaders: Piotr Ożarowski <piotr@debian.org>, Stefano Rivera <stefanor@debian.org>
 Build-Depends: debhelper (>= 11), @bd_i586@
   lsb-release,
diff --git a/debian/python3.postinst.in b/debian/python3.postinst.in
index 0290269..57a03c4 100644
--- a/debian/python3.postinst.in
+++ b/debian/python3.postinst.in
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@ new_config_file()
 
 case "$1" in
     configure)
+	_py_errors=
 	[ -d /etc/python3 ] || mkdir /etc/python3
 	[ -f /etc/python3/debian_config ] || new_config_file
 
@@ -24,10 +25,10 @@ case "$1" in
 	    if ! $hook rtupdate python$oldv @PVER@; then
 	        hb=$(basename $hook .rtupdate)
 	        echo >&2 "error running python rtupdate hook $hb"
-	        errors=yes
+	        _py_errors=yes
 	    fi
 	done
-	[ -z "$errors" ] || exit 4
+	[ -z "$_py_errors" ] || exit 4
 
 	if [ "$DEBIAN_FRONTEND" != noninteractive ]; then
 	    echo "running python post-rtupdate hooks for @PVER@..."
@@ -37,10 +38,10 @@ case "$1" in
 	    if ! $hook post-rtupdate python$oldv @PVER@; then
 	        hb=$(basename $hook .rtupdate)
 	        echo >&2 "error running python post-rtupdate hook $hb"
-	        errors=yes
+	        _py_errors=yes
 	    fi
 	done
-	[ -z "$errors" ] || exit 5
+	[ -z "$_py_errors" ] || exit 5
 esac
 
 if which py3compile >/dev/null 2>&1; then
diff --git a/debian/python3.preinst.in b/debian/python3.preinst.in
index d385b2e..e2b6ae2 100644
--- a/debian/python3.preinst.in
+++ b/debian/python3.preinst.in
@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@ update-alternatives --auto /usr/bin/python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 
 case "$1" in
     upgrade)
+	_py_errors=
 	oldv=$(echo $2 | sed 's/^\(...\).*/\1/')
 	if [ "$DEBIAN_FRONTEND" != noninteractive ]; then
 	    echo "running python pre-rtupdate hooks for @PVER@..."
@@ -20,11 +21,11 @@ case "$1" in
 		echo >&2 "error running python pre-rtupdate hook $hb"
 		echo >&2 "running python failed-pre-rtupdate hook $hb"
 		$hook failed-pre-rtupdate python$oldv @PVER@
-		errors=yes
+		_py_errors=yes
 		break
 	    fi
 	done
-	[ -z "$errors" ] || exit 3
+	[ -z "$_py_errors" ] || exit 3
 esac
 
 #DEBHELPER#
